title: Facebook will let you customize your feed algorithm using AI
key_facts: Meta is bringing the "Your Algorithm" feature, launched on Instagram earlier this year, to Facebook (The Verge).
Users can add and manage topics they want to see in their feed and Facebook Reels, or tap "interested" or "not interested" from the three dots menu or buttons under posts.
Meta says recommendations "respond right away" after these updates and it may ask follow-up questions, and users can say in their own words what they want more or less of.
Meta also launched a similar "Dear Algo" feature on Threads.

The feature is part of "AI-powered" tools; Meta says it is using large language models (LLMs) more in its ranking systems, which "can incorporate the interests, context, and intent behind natural language".
quote_evidence: Facebook’s new “Your Algorithm” feature will let you directly add and manage topics you want to see in your feed and Facebook Reels.
Your Algorithm previously launched on Instagram earlier this year, and Meta also launched a similar “Dear Algo” feature on Threads.
It also says it’s using LLMs more in its ranking systems
why_it_matters_hint: Facebook users get direct, plain-language control over what their feed recommends, using AI to rank posts.
notes: Short article. No rollout date, country list or independent test is given; the "real time" claim is Meta's own.
